note: Current-release digital-engine registration baseline after implementing Revolution through a shared post-reroll exchange window. Current Action parity remains 74/74. Current battle parity is 81/113, leaving 32 unsupported battle surfaces. Revolution resolves only after all Fate's Toll and Valor rerolls are complete; each Revolution is then an optional shared-timing effect, attacker first and alternating while effects remain. Using it swaps only the players' final selected die results and recalculates each battle total with that player's own modifier. If both players exchange once, the second exchange restores the original die ownership, matching the current card rule note. Registration remains a surface census, not a claim that every historically registered behavior has been fully revalidated against all v0.7.2 semantic changes.
